warns.msg: the section is only text: no picture, icon, mock or effect in it
warns.fix: give the section a visual: a photograph that fits, the real icons, or a UI fragment on a ground

warns.msg: 2 labels for one target /app/: "Otvoriť appku", "Vyskúšať v prehliadači"
warns.fix: few actions, one wording: at most 2 in the hero, the main action word for word in nav, hero and close

warns.msg: 181px between these sections, -38% against the median 291px
